osq_prompt: According to MIL-STD-167 vibration testing criteria, what performance requirements must shipboard equipment meet to pass? List all required conditions. Answer in 1–2 sentences.
expected_answer: It must remain fully operational throughout the vibration exposure, show no physical damage or deformation, and stay securely mounted without loosening or detaching.

rubric.full_credit: 3 points total. Award 1 point for each of the following clearly stated conditions: (1) Continuous correct operation/functional performance during vibration (acceptable phrasings: "remains fully operational," "operates correctly," "no loss of function"). (2) No physical damage or deformation (acceptable: "no structural damage," "no mechanical damage," "no visible deformation/cracking"). (3) Secure mounting retained (acceptable: "remains securely mounted," "no loosening or detachment," "mounting hardware integrity maintained"). Extraneous correct details do not affect credit if all three are present.
rubric.partial_credit: 2 points: Exactly two of the three required conditions are correctly stated. 1 point: Exactly one required condition is correctly stated, or two are implied but vague (e.g., "passes without issues" plus one explicit condition). Do not deduct for minor wording as long as intent is clear. Common acceptable variants: "no degradation of performance" for functionality; "no physical/structural compromise" for damage; "securely attached" for mounting.
rubric.no_credit: 0 points if none of the three conditions is stated, or the answer is off-topic (e.g., discusses test frequencies/procedures only), or includes a disqualifying error (e.g., claims the equipment may shut down during testing, or that cosmetic damage is acceptable, or that detachment is permissible). Answers naming only general compliance without specifics earn 0.

blooms_justification: The task requires recalling specific pass/fail criteria from MIL-STD-167 without interpretation or application.
